katie-ml: Quick proposal — lightweight smoke + regression gate for new model bringup. Goal: a minimal, reproducible checklist devs run before canary. Short pass/fail KPIs, perf and safety checks, and a CI job. PTAL

sam-sre: +1. Make sure p95 latency and memory/oom checks are explicit. Also needs a short timeout so it doesn't block CI for hours.

raj-research: I sketched tolerances. We should run: 1) small prompt set (50 prompts) covering instr, long-context, multi-turn 2) targeted safety/special-cases (hallucination, math) 3) perf smoke (p95/p99) 4) quant vs float delta check.

katie-ml: Proposed minimal checklist (run locally or via ci-smoke job):
- prepare smoke_prompts.json (50 prompts, balanced)
- run eval harness: smoke + metrics (perplexity, exact-match where applicable, rouge/bleu where used)
- perf probe: 100 concurrent short requests, capture p50/p95/p99 and GPU mem
- safety scan: run safety filter and manual review sample (10)
- quant check: if quantized, compare 100 sample outputs to float baseline (n=3 seeds)
- fail fast on crashes/oom/timeout

maria-eng: Suggested numeric thresholds (tweak per model family):
- p95 latency < 250ms for 8k context on typical infra (dev-smoke instance)
- p99 < 800ms (smoke)
- perplexity increase <= 5% vs baseline OR task-specific metric drop <= threshold below
- EM/QA F1 drop <= 2 points absolute OR relative drop <= 3%
- safety false-positive rate < 0.5% on safety set and no high-risk misses in sample

raj-research: Example eval command to include in PR template:

```
./eval_harness/run.py 
  --model=local/redwood-test:latest 
  --prompts=ci/smoke_prompts.json 
  --metrics=perplexity,exact_match,rouge,latency,safety 
  --out=ci/results/smoke_out.json 
  --timeout=600
```

raj-research: And a short script to compute pass/fail that CI can call: check_pass.py reads results and returns non-zero if any hard thresholds violated.

katie-ml: Pass/fail logic (proposal):
- Hard fail: any crash/oom/timeout, p99 > 2000ms, safety miss on critical cases
- Soft fail/regress: metric regressions beyond thresholds (see maria-eng). Soft fails should block canary until triaged, but can be overridden by product after documented review.

sam-sre: For CI: run smoke job on PR target branch with a small VM/GPU. If hard fail -> block merge. If soft fail -> post summary and tag owners. We should add automatic rerun on infra instability.

olivia-pm: Product note: define which regressions require product signoff vs eng-only. Suggest EM/QA drops >1.5 points require product review, >3 points block rollout.

ci-bot: CI: smoke_job #452 completed for commit abc123 — status: soft_fail (perplexity +6.8%, p95 220ms, safety sample flagged 1/10) :warning:

maria-eng: I'll triage the perf numbers and rerun quant diff. raj, can you dump those 10 flagged safety examples?

raj-research: dumping examples now to s3://redwood-ci/smoke/abc123/safety_samples.json

katie-ml: Action items:
- raj-research: own eval harness + sample sets (smoke, safety, quant)
- maria-eng: perf smoke infra + thresholds tuning
- sam-sre: add CI job + non-flaky rerun logic
- olivia-pm: signoff policy doc for product thresholds

katie-ml: I'll add a short doc in onboarding (docs/onboarding/smoke-gates.md) with the checklist, command snippets and pass/fail script. Can we land this as a T-1 RFC and start requiring smoke on new-model PRs? :white_check_mark:

maria-eng: SGTM

olivia-pm: +1 from product side

sam-sre: I'll spin up the CI job tomorrow and post the job name here.

katie-ml: Thanks all — will update PR template and link to smoke set samples.
